source_notes: CP table p.15 (page 23 of txt): C02 WA2 'Handle bills collection' has two performance criteria both numbered '2.1'. The first is 'Selected bills from mails and hand delivery compiled...' and the second (which should logically be 2.3) is 'Bills collection report prepared...'. Both are transcribed exactly as printed; neither is an error introduced here.

CoCU p.64 (page 73 of txt): C06 WA1 Assessment Criteria item 1.5 reads only '1.5 Document' — the sentence is cut off mid-word in the extracted text with no continuation on the next page. The truncated item is transcribed as printed; no content has been invented to complete it.

Section 6 'Occupational Competencies' (p.6) lists C07 as 'Staff Administration Supervision'. The CPC chart (p.11) and CoCU 15.7 (p.71) also use 'Staff Administration Supervision'. This is consistent throughout the standard and is transcribed verbatim. A previous project deliverable mislabelled this unit — see CLAUDE.md project note.

competency_units.descriptor: Front Office Reception describes the first point of contact of visitors at the office and handling them professionally. The person competent in this CU should be able to attend to visitors, handle office incoming/outgoing communication, handle office incoming/outgoing items and record front office reception activities.

performance_criteria.text: Visitor greeted in accordance with meet and greet guidelines.
Issue acknowledged which include enquiry, complaint and delivery in accordance with organization requirements.
Action taken in accordance with organization requirements.
Issue delegated to department/person concerned in accordance with organization requirements.
Incoming/outgoing communication acknowledged which include telephone, fax, email and postage in accordance with organization requirements.
Recipient communication acknowledged in accordance with organization directory.
Communication information generated in accordance with organization requirements.
Items which includes mails, documents and parcel confirmed with intended owner.
Items notification provided to recipient and of mode delivery acknowledged in accordance with organization requirements.
Item delivery record generated in accordance with organization requirements.
Reception activities related information compiled.
Accuracy of compiled information confirmed.
Front office reception activities report prepared accordance with organization requirement.

competency_units.descriptor: Office Procurement Handling describes the acquisition of office required materials and process in procurement cycle of the organization.
